fusions.name: Grapnel Haul
fusions.desc: Casts the tines out on a line and hauls yourself along it: you rush a target up to 7 tiles away and strike it for 12 damage.

fusions.name: Rattling Links
fusions.desc: Whirls the links around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Each blow leaps on to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: Anchor Line
fusions.desc: Anchors a line of links 5 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward.

fusions.name: Whipping Slack
fusions.desc: Each time you strike with your weapon, a link lashes the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 5 damage, then leaps on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage. Once every 4 seconds.
